nodes.description: Mapping _rOwned tracking reflection balances per address; mutated in _transferStandard and _takeTeam.
Mapping _allowances storing ERC20 spending approvals; mutated in _approve and read in transferFrom.
Mapping bots marking addresses blocked from transferring; written in setBots and delBot, read in _transfer.
Mapping cooldown storing per-address timestamp gates set from block.timestamp in _transfer.
Total reflection supply _rTotal, reduced by fees in _reflectFee.
Maximum transfer amount _maxTxAmount enforced in _transfer cooldown branch.
Boolean swapEnabled enabling automatic fee swapping, set in openTrading and read in _transfer.
Address of the Uniswap V2 pair, assigned in openTrading and compared in _transfer.
Uniswap V2 router interface used for swaps, liquidity and WETH queries.
Fee recipient wallet address receiving ETH via sendETHToFee and authorizing manualswap/manualsend.
Boolean tradingOpen flag guarding openTrading against repeated initialization.
Core private transfer routine applying fees, bot checks, cooldown and automatic liquidity swaps.
Public ERC20 transfer entry point forwarding msg.sender to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that moves tokens then reduces allowance.
Private lockTheSwap helper swapping contract tokens to ETH via the router.
Private helper splitting contract ETH balance to the two fee wallets via raw transfers.
Owner-only initialization creating the Uniswap pair and adding initial liquidity.
Fee-wallet-only function triggering a manual token-to-ETH swap of contract balance.
Fee-wallet-only function distributing contract ETH balance to fee wallets.
Owner-only function blacklisting an array of addresses in the bots mapping.
Owner-only function removing an address from the bots blacklist.
Context helper returning msg.sender.
Core reflection accounting routine updating _rOwned balances, team tokens and fees.
Public ERC20 approve entry point delegating to _approve with msg.sender.
Private approval writer updating the _allowances mapping.
msg.sender, untrusted caller identity used for authorization and transfer origin.
block.timestamp, miner-influenceable time source used in cooldown gates and swap deadlines.
External call to uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with attacker-influenceable path.
External payable call to uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH forwarding contract ETH balance.
Raw ETH transfer to _feeAddrWallet1/_feeAddrWallet2 inside sendETHToFee.
Parameter from of _transfer, the token source address.
Parameter to of _transfer, the token destination address.
Parameter amount of _transfer, the token amount to move.
Parameter tokenAmount of swapTokensForEth.
Parameter bots_ array of addresses to blacklist in setBots.
Parameter notbot address to unblacklist in delBot.
Parameter sender of _transferStandard.
Parameter recipient of _transferStandard.
Parameter tAmount of _transferStandard, the token amount to convert to reflections.
Local contractTokenBalance holding the contract token balance before swapping.
Local contractETHBalance holding the contract ETH balance before fee distribution.
Local path array of swap route addresses [token, WETH].

edges.reason: _msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
transfer uses _msgSender as the origin address for _transfer.
msg.sender is the caller-controlled sender in transfer.
msg.sender supplies the spender identity in transferFrom allowance reduction.
manualswap authorizes based on comparison of _msgSender with _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorizes based on comparison of _msgSender with _feeAddrWallet1.
transfer invokes the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom invokes the internal _transfer routine before reducing allowance.
_transfer delegates balance accounting to _transferStandard via _tokenTransfer.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth which performs an external router call.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee which pushes ETH to fee wallets.
swapTokensForEth invokes the external router swap operation before state settles.
swapTokensForEth reads the uniswapV2Router state variable.
sendETHToFee performs raw ETH transfers to fee wallets.
sendETHToFee reads the _feeAddrWallet1 payout address.
openTrading calls the external addLiquidityETH router operation.
openTrading assigns and reads the uniswapV2Router state variable.
openTrading assigns the uniswapV2Pair state variable.
openTrading enables the swapEnabled state variable.
openTrading sets the tradingOpen state variable.
block.timestamp gates the cooldown requirement and is written into the cooldown mapping.
block.timestamp supplies the swap deadline argument.
block.timestamp supplies the liquidity deadline argument.
cooldown mapping is read and written to enforce per-address time gating in _transfer.
bots mapping is checked to block flagged addresses in _transfer.
_maxTxAmount constrains the transfer amount in the cooldown branch.
swapEnabled controls the automatic swap branch in _transfer.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to to detect liquidity transfers.
_rOwned balances are read and written with arithmetic in _transferStandard.
_transferStandard indirectly reduces _rTotal through fee reflection accounting.
from parameter flows into _transfer token movement logic.
to parameter flows into _transfer token movement logic.
amount parameter is constrained and used in _transfer arithmetic.
tokenAmount parameter determines the swap input size.
bots_ parameter addresses are written into the bots mapping.
notbot parameter address is cleared from the bots mapping.
sender parameter indexes the _rOwned debit in _transferStandard.
recipient parameter indexes the _rOwned credit in _transferStandard.
tAmount parameter drives fee and reflection arithmetic in _transferStandard.
contractTokenBalance local is passed as the swap input to swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance local is forwarded to sendETHToFee.
path local builds the swap route used by the router call.
External router swap can re-enter transfer accounting before _rOwned state is finalized.
setBots writes blacklist flags into the bots mapping.
_allowances mapping is read by transferFrom to reduce the spender allowance.
approve delegates the write to the private _approve helper.
_approve writes the allowance value into the _allowances mapping.

Parameter amount is only consumed by _transfer and should be folded into that core function.
Parameter tokenAmount is only consumed by swapTokensForEth and should be folded into that unsafe swap function.
Parameter bots_ is only consumed by setBots and should be folded into that core function.
Parameter notbot is only consumed by delBot and should be folded into that core function.
Parameter sender is only consumed by _transferStandard and should be folded into that core function.
Parameter recipient is only consumed by _transferStandard and should be folded into that core function.
Parameter tAmount is only consumed by _transferStandard and should be folded into that core function.
Local contractTokenBalance is produced for and consumed by swapTokensForEth.
Local contractETHBalance is produced for and consumed by sendETHToFee.
Local path array is constructed solely for the router swap in swapTokensForEth.
